title: Skill Invocations
description: Query strings below are plain-English-adjacent pseudo-SQL, not copy-paste-ready syntax for any specific Grafana datasource plugin — no real backend/datasource is wired up in this build. Source: obs.v1 skill.invoked events in ~/.claude/metrics/events/*.ndjson, emitted by payload/hooks/pipeline-relay.sh for every Skill tool call, regardless of whether that skill has a relay message defined (Phase 1). Charts attrs.skill_name (the skill's leaf name, lowercased, with any plugin prefix like "superpowers:" stripped).

targets.query: SELECT attrs.skill_name, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'skill.invoked' GROUP BY attrs.skill_name ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.title: Invocations over time
panels.description: Source: obs.v1 skill.invoked events, counted per time bucket.

targets.query: SELECT time_bucket(ts) AS bucket, count(*) FROM obs_events WHERE event = 'skill.invoked' GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
